name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A vertical bar chart made of plain divs. The tallest bar is highlighted, values show on hover or all the time, and the full data is read aloud.

props.name: data
props.description: One bar per item, left to right, each with a label and a value.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the plot in pixels.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Show each value above its bar. Otherwise the value shows for the bar you hover.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats a value for display. Defaults to en-US grouping.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. A summary of the data is added after it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the bars to grow in.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds between one bar and the next.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
